summary: It is now possible to share all public tracks and playlists to the connections of the authenticated user. So if a user is already connected e.g. with Facebook on SoundCloud, this connection can be used from your app to share a track.

title: New Activities
summary: Today we announce new activities available over the API. As a reminder: Activites are the items on your Dashboard.

title: New Sharing Interface
summary: Today we announce a better way to share sounds in SoundCloud via the API. The new interface resembles the way sharing happens on the website. You can retrieve, create, update and delete sharings to other users on SoundCloud based on user_id or email address for your tracks and playlists.
